findings.title: Splash biometric unlock enforces nothing
findings.detail: The splash calls service.authenticate(...) when the user has opted in but explicitly discards the result ('access is already granted'), so an opted-in user reaches /home whether or not the biometric check passes.
findings.recommendation: Treat it as a visual affordance, not access control, until the deferred phase3+ re-auth gate wires real enforcement. Matches the plan's stated OPTIONAL/NON-BLOCKING design; non-blocking.

findings.title: Password-reset email cannot reach /auth/reset
findings.detail: A recovery email establishes an authenticated session, and the guard bounces authenticated users off /auth/* to /home, so the email-link -> /auth/reset flow does not complete end-to-end. The screen is reachable only by an unauthenticated user navigating directly.
findings.recommendation: Implement the documented AuthChangeEvent.passwordRecovery -> /auth/reset routing in a later phase. Explicitly scoped out of Phase 3 by the plan; non-blocking.

findings.title: local_auth 3.0.2 adaptation is compile-checked only
findings.detail: pubspec.lock resolves local_auth 3.0.2, whose API differs from the plan's pinned 2.x signature (direct named params, no stickyAuth, LocalAuthException). The adapted authenticate(...) call and broad catch compile under dart analyze but have no runtime verification.
findings.recommendation: Confirm the 3.x call on a real device via the deferred flutter build. Non-blocking.

findings.title: Flutter verification gates not executed
findings.detail: flutter test and flutter build web are deferred under the flutter deny. dart pub get and dart analyze (no issues) are recorded, proving every screen and test compiles, but no runtime assertion exists that screens render, the guard redirects live, or OTP paste/auto-advance works.
findings.recommendation: Run flutter test and flutter build web --dart-define=SUPABASE_URL=<url> --dart-define=SUPABASE_ANON_KEY=<anon-key> (cwd apps/user_app) when the deny lifts. Explicitly non-blocking per the task.

findings.title: Sign-out swallows errors silently
findings.detail: Settings' signOut() is wrapped in catch (_) that surfaces nothing, so a failed sign-out gives the user no feedback (staying logged in is a safe default).
findings.recommendation: Low priority; consider surfacing an inline failure message if signOut throws. Non-blocking.

findings.title: admin_web modified outside the Phase 3 window
findings.detail: Files under apps/admin_web changed at 02:58-03:06, just after the user_app Phase 3 work (02:37-02:57). This is attributable to the parallel admin track that owns admin_web (its task doc is open in the editor and the plan assigns admin_web to a parallel track), not to Phase 3. shared_core, including lib/services, is untouched.
findings.recommendation: Informational only; confirm the parallel admin track (not this change) produced those edits. Not a Phase 3 scope violation; non-blocking.
